about: Inputs for breakage.html. The presets and volumes describe a made-up loyalty programme and are illustrative assumptions, not any airline's data. The benchmarks are copied from published annual reports (amounts in millions of the reporting currency).

fast.label: Fast
fast.desc: Leisure-heavy base, low award thresholds, lots of cash-and-points.

typical.label: Typical
typical.desc: Mixed base; most engaged members redeem within two to three years.

slow.label: Slow
slow.desc: Many occasional members and aspirational long-haul awards.

benchmarks.note: Includes other deferred revenues, which are not broken out. No roll-forward of the balance is published.
benchmarks.expiry: 18 months without account activity; no expiry for Aeroplan co-brand cardholders and elite members
benchmarks.source: Air Canada 2025 audited consolidated financial statements, statement of financial position (p. 9) and note 2E

benchmarks.note: Redeemed = travel miles redeemed (3,414) + non-travel miles redeemed (133).
benchmarks.source: United Airlines Holdings 2025 Form 10-K, consolidated balance sheet and frequent flyer deferred revenue roll-forward

benchmarks.note: Redeemed = travel miles redeemed (4,237) + non-travel miles redeemed and other.
benchmarks.source: Delta Air Lines 2025 Form 10-K, consolidated balance sheet and loyalty program activity table

benchmarks.note: Presented entirely as a current liability. Flying Blue 855 + BlueBiz 66 in 2025 (831 + 75 in 2024); the roll-forward covers Flying Blue only.
benchmarks.expiry: Miles valid 2 years, extended by each qualifying activity
benchmarks.source: Air France-KLM Universal Registration Document 2025, consolidated balance sheet (p. 379) and note 33 (p. 452)
